# Contributing to apolovyi.me

## Workflow

**All changes go through feature branches and PRs.** No direct commits to `main`.

### Branch Naming

```
feature/<description>    # New features
fix/<description>        # Bug fixes
content/<description>    # Content updates (blog posts, text)
style/<description>      # Design/styling changes
```

### Pull Request Process

1. Create feature branch from `main`
2. Make changes, commit with clear messages
3. Push branch, open PR
4. Wait for automated reviews:
   - ✅ GitHub Copilot code review
   - ✅ Claude code review
5. Address feedback if needed
6. Merge when approved

### Code Review

PRs automatically trigger reviews from:
- **GitHub Copilot** — code quality, suggestions
- **Claude** — architecture, patterns, accessibility

Do not merge until both have reviewed.
